Morning Consult found that in the second quarter of 2026, 54% of registered voters in Virginia approved of the job Spanberger is doing, compared to 37% who disapproved.

Meagher said that while he cautions putting too much stock in one poll,the Morning Consult poll is good news for Spanberger, especially compared to a previous VCU poll that showed her approval rating underwater. [...] Meagher said Trump’s popularity will be part of the national story surrounding the midterm elections.

“I do think that Trump’s numbers should be concerning to not just the Trump administration and Republicans nationally, but Republicans here in Virginia,” Meagher said.
